scripts.test: npm run compile:core && pnpm --filter @styleconstitution/cli build && pnpm --filter @styleconstitution/sdk build && node --test tests/*.test.mjs
scripts.build:portable: npm run clean && npm run compile:core && npm run generate && node scripts/build-docs-portable.mjs
scripts.build: npm run build:portable && pnpm --filter @styleconstitution/cli build && pnpm --filter @styleconstitution/sdk build && npm run build:docs
scripts.verify:core: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run validate && npm run build:portable && npm run repro && npm run audit && npm run evidence
scripts.verify: pnpm lint && pnpm lint:eslint && pnpm typecheck:full && pnpm test && pnpm validate && pnpm generate && pnpm repro && pnpm build:docs && pnpm smoke:mcp && pnpm audit && pnpm evidence
